title: The Word Serendipity
short_teaser: The word serendipity was coined in the eighteenth century after a story about princes who made discoveries through observation and good judgment.
story: The word serendipity was coined in the eighteenth century after a story about princes who made discoveries through observation and good judgment. It came to describe valuable findings that occur while looking for something else. Serendipity is not pure luck; it often rewards a prepared and attentive mind. Words shape what we notice and remember. Naming an experience can make it easier to understand, share, and use. The lasting value is not merely knowing the fact. It is seeing the pattern beneath it and considering where that same pattern may already be present in ordinary life, creative work, or business.
